Krenalis USA — Demo Plausible

This is synthetic demonstration data, not a representative population,
statistical certification, empirical validation or prediction of actual people.
Names, employers, identities, addresses, observations and economic facts are
synthetic. Company/Employer relationships belong to the synthetic company roster.

Income is gross personal monetary annualized income in USD, integer dollars
(decimalPlaces 0), period year, anchor 2026-01-01, ages 21–75. It is not EUR,
monthly income, household income or inflation-adjusted individual evidence.
Qualification: Demo Plausible. External admission remains pending the documented
publication decisions and reviews. EMPIRICAL TOTAL INCOME VALIDATION = REVIEW. The six income laws are synthetic editorial assumptions,
not official statistics or complete empirical validation; they make no claim of
observed conditional independence or empirically observed zero rates. Economic
parameters, supports, weights, seeds and streams are unchanged.

The photographs are AI-generated synthetic images. The owner states that they
personally generated the photographs using OpenAI APIs and hold the corresponding
rights, and authorized preparation of this corpus for manual publication. This
records the owner's declaration; it is not independent legal certification or an
attestation about third-party rights. No agency or service endorsement is claimed.

GeoNames Postal Code Data — USA, historical archive dated 2015-06-15.
Author/provider: GeoNames, https://www.geonames.org/
Source: https://www.geonames.org/export/zip/US.zip
Original notice: https://www.geonames.org/export/zip/readme.txt
License: Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported (CC BY 3.0),
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/
Changes: selected 127 localities; verified states; removed unresolved ZIP aliases
and unqualified entries; deduplicated and ordered associations; assigned synthetic
locality identifiers and editorial weights proportional to state populations,
using municipal observations and four declared editorial coverage floors.
GeoNames does not warrant accuracy, timeliness or completeness. Neither GeoNames
nor USPS endorses this data. Retain attribution, source/license links and the
changes notice when redistributing the postal data or adaptations. No additional
Elastic License restrictions are imposed on the GeoNames material.

U.S. Census Bureau — 2020 Census Frequently Occurring Names (April 2026),
Population Estimates Vintage 2025, Census Regions/Divisions, 2024 ACS and
2022 Statistics of U.S. Businesses.
https://www.census.gov/topics/population/genealogy/data/2020_names.html
https://www.census.gov/programs-surveys/acs/microdata/documentation/2024.html
https://www.census.gov/data/datasets/2022/econ/susb/2022-susb.html
The name catalogs use public edited aggregate counts, not individual records.
The selected support is 50,000 surnames and 1,000 first names per gender/cohort;
BASE-v2 applies editorial natural capitalization while preserving sampling inputs.
No SSA archive is distributed. No CPS/ACS microdata is distributed in this package.
Government-employee works generally lack copyright protection within the US;
no worldwide CC0 claim or Census/SSA endorsement is asserted.
https://www2.census.gov/foia/ds_policies/ds027.pdf
https://www.census.gov/about/policies/citation.html

Numbering-plan rule: 368 adopted geographic NPAs; synthetic telephone numbers use
the reserved 555-0100 through 555-0199 interval. The geographic assignment and
historical policy are the frozen inputs of this USA demonstration.
https://reports.nanpa.com/public/npa_report.csv
